welcome.faq1Label: How often should I service my Iveco?
welcome.faq1Content: The manufacturer recommends maintenance every 20,000/45,000/75,000 km depending on engine type, or once a year — depending on operating conditions. For harsh conditions (dust, short trips, mountains) the interval may be shortened. Our technicians will provide an individual recommendation after diagnostics.
welcome.faq2Label: Which Iveco models do you service?
welcome.faq2Content: We service the entire model range: Iveco Daily, Eurocargo, Stralis, Trakker and others. We have experience with all generations and engines from Euro 3 to Euro 6.
welcome.faq3Label: How can I find out the repair cost?
welcome.faq3Content: Call us or leave a request on the website — we will consult you for free and provide an estimated cost. The exact price is determined after diagnostics.
welcome.faq4Content: Yes, and we recommend it. Book by phone or through the website form — this will allow us to prepare and save your time.
